column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 41. `UV:3773-3817` a `ByteSequenceWrite` is accepted with no predicate check when `byte_write_predicates` returns `None`.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 42. `UV:3750-3752`, `UV:3771` a fixed byte store is accepted with no ASCII freshness when `requires_ascii` is `None` or `Some(false)`; "a destination whose byte predicates cannot be computed is accepted here".
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 43. `UV:4479` `may_change_owned_source` ends `_ => false`; `ElementViewWrite` is not in its list.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 44. `UV:5455-5457` ASCII establishment trusts a declared qualification on any structural result at the root.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 45. `UV:5793` the cycle error is skipped for admitted machines; which machines are admitted is decided by callers of `UV:18229` (pipeline 00 `artifact_admission.rs:1126`, pipeline 01 `pass_manager.rs:1313`), not read.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 46. `UV:6724-6727` a place with no recorded producer is skipped in the availability check. Wrong program: "an operation reading a place that nothing produces".

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `unit_validation.rs` (40)** | 48. `UV:7517-7550` `Field` operands of `ByteSequenceEqual` and `ByteSequencePredicate` are not examined. Wrong program: "a `Field` operand whose field/length does not exist or is erased".
